verses.text: yazuuruka minii haysu maa kuntu yaa muh-yi
fu-aadii wa ruuhii bil bushaarati zaa tayyi
yahuddu mazaayaakal latii lan tihaa lahaa
madiihil lazii alzamtuhun nafsa bis sah-yi
yaqiinii yaqiinii tarka amdaahi sayyidin
kafanii bihil baaqii zawiz zulmi wal ghayyi
yamiinii halayhaa daynu khattin hawaa ridan
bikhidmati khillii zil madiinati zaa had-yi
yusallii bitasliimin halaykal lazii nafat
bihi qabdatun minkal ahaadiya bir ram-yi
yajii-uka minnii kulla waqtin wa saahatin
ridaa-un wa shukrun raafaqal hubba fil hayyi
yusalii bitasliimin halaykum bi-aalikum
wa as-haabikum baaqin habaanii bil wah-yi
yubashshirukal baaqii bikhattii karaamatan
wa in kuntu han ardil madiinati zaa na-yi
yuwajjihu rabii kulla maa laa uhibbuhu
lighayrii bikad daarayni yaa jaalibal waq-yi
yuwassilu lil baaqii bushaaraati naafihin
bikad dahra yaa zas sabqi wal fadli wa wal-yi
yubajjilu kulli kullakal yawma mah ghadin
wa in shaa-a rabbii laa urad dahra zaa wan-yi
yuwakkidu kullii habla hubbii wa khidmatii
biman qaada lii khayral maqaamaati bit tayyi
kharajtu bifadlil laahi mimmaa yuwabbikhu
wa yanhuu liqawmin faaraqunii muwabbikhu
kharajtu bifadlil laahi min kulli baatilin
ilal haqqi wal iimaanu bil laahi yarsakhu
khazaa-inu rabbii futtihat lii wa zahzahat
lighayril azaa dunyaa wa ukhraa wa barzakhu
khuzish shukra minnii akhzaa rafhin wa bashshiran
bihil mustafaa yaa khayra haadin yushayyakhu
kharajtu mahal maahii birabbii minal azaa
walaa yantahii nahwil lazii yatabazzakhu
khitaabuka yaa khayral baraayaa sahaadatii
yu-amminu kullii yawma fis suuri yunfakhu
khadabtal hidaa hannii wa zahzahta man taghaw
ilaa ghayrinaa wal kullu qad kaana yablakhu
khadiimuka raadin hanka faqbal shukuurahu
liwajhil lazii min hubbihi fiika yansakhu
khatii-aatuhu hanhu ummahat bahda tawbatin
libaaqin lahu habdun ilayhi ta-awwukhu
khuzil haama yaa mukhtaaru lil laahi khidmatii
halayka salaamaa man bihi fiika atnakhu
kharajtu minal matruuki bil laahi wahdahu
wa bayhii lahu bayhun bihi laysa yufsakhu
khuruujii birabbii mahka min qabli haksashin
wa yanhuu lighayrii laa linahwii muwabbikhu
lirabii khuruujii mah dukhuulii bimanizili
mahaa qablahu maa qad madaa min tazalzuli
lahush shukru aydan bahda hamdin mukhalladin
halal mustafaa khayril baraayal mufaddali
lirabbii tahaalaa sirtu habdan mukhaatiban
liman fadluhu baadin ladaa zii tahaqquli
laqad jaa-akum qad jaa-anaa maadihan lakum
minal laahi zil harshil haziimil mufaddili
laqad jaa-a fil qur-aani maada lanaa halaa
taqaddumikal muhtil hataa-il mukammali
la-antal lazii uhtiita qidman nubuwwatan
wa aadamu baynal maa-i wat tiini yanjalii
likullin minal akhyaari fadlun wa rutbatun
wa maa kabni habdil laahi habdun ladal halii
likullin minas saadaati jaahun wa hurmatun
walaa kinna jaahal mustafal barri yahtalii
la-in jaaha bil aayaati ruslun taqaddumuu
fanaaluu bikal aayaati min zit tafadduli
lizil harshi qad aslamtu kullii bijaahikum
wa zaadii ilaa jannaatihi khayru munzali
lakum rumtu min rabbii salaamayhi sarmadan
mahal aali wal as-haabi yaa khayra mursali
lirabbil lazii raadal hidaa lii bijaahikum
shukriya bahdal hamdi duunat tazalzuli
qadin sarafat haajii ilaa faatiqir ratqi
wa innii lahu habdun wa lii jaada bihitqi
qilaamii halayhaa daynu shukrin lahu halaa
firaaqii bilaa luq-yaa zawil jawri wal fisqi
qilaa-u  zawil ishraaki lii qaada kulla maa
rajawtu wa innii zuu shukuurin halal farqi
quluubu zawil hudwaani siiqat lighayrinaa
ka-abdanihim wal laahu lii maskanii yubqi
qasadtu shukuural laahi shukran mutayyaban
ukhaatibu khayral khalqi bil khalqi wal khulqi
qadamta bitaqdiimil haalii yaa rasuulanaa
wa huztal hulaa yaa naasiral haqqi bil haqqi
qada anzala aayaatin lakal laahu qad nafat
lighayri siwaa man khaarahum lii minal khalqi
qahartu bihaa ahlal qilaa wah-ya junnatun
bihaa saananil baaqii wa ahlaa bihaa ufqi
qiraa-a tuhaa kanzii wa jaahii wa hizzatii
uniltu bihaa kawnii ladal laahi zaa sidqi
qarubtu bihaa min muzilin kaana lii bihaa
wa ardaytuhu bish shukri bil fihli wan nutqi
qarirtu bihaa haynan wa lin nafsa tayyabat
wa saltu bihaa lil laahi zil fatqi war ratqi
qadal laahu haajaatii biman jaa-anaa bihaa
wa innii bihaa habdun khadiimun mahal hitqi
